reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close below $62,964.3 - this session's low, printed on the 09:00Z bar. The line moves DOWN 79.1 points from endday's 63,043.4, which fired and was settled through four consecutive times, and a level price trades through is a range boundary rather than an exit. Today's midnight session, working the same tape independently four minutes earlier, arrived at the identical 62,964.3 by the identical session-low rule - two independent derivations landing on the same number is the strongest support this level has had all week. It keeps the exit 118.0 points ABOVE the 62,846.3 invalidation. Note what the line means now: 62,964.3 was tested once and held, and the four 1H bars after it settled 62,986.1, 63,009.1, 63,012.4 and 63,010.6 - rising closes off the low. A settled close back below it would mean the base built after the flush has failed, a materially different event from the first probe.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close above $63,155.8 - this session's high. This is the one place this report deliberately parts company with midnight, which held its add gate at 63,309.4 for a SEVENTH consecutive session. That gate has now gone seven reports without a single test; the session high fell 153.6 points short again today, and a level price has not approached in seven reports is not a gate, it is decoration. Anchoring the add to the session high mirrors the rule already used for the reduce line and makes both ends of the box produce a testable claim every session. 63,155.8 sits 95.3 points above spot and just under yesterday's 63,172.1 high, so a settled close above it reclaims the session high and confirms this morning's break to 62,964.3 as a failed breakdown. Pair it with open interest holding its gain: OI has just turned up after five consecutive declines, and an add that arrives with leverage rising is a different trade from one that arrives on short-covering alone.

calibration.note: The prior report for this session is today's 2026-08-16-midnight, published at 08:26:00-05:00 with spot at 63,063.4. It is four minutes old. Its reduce line at 62,964.3 has not had a single settled 1H bar to fire against and its add gate at 63,309.4 is 246.0 points away, so priorReduceFired and actingHelped are null: there is no elapsed window to rate and inventing one would be worse than leaving it empty. The midnight session was late - it landed at roughly 08:26 COT rather than its scheduled 02:00 - and its report was not yet on disk when this session started collecting data, so the two ran concurrently and read the tape independently. They converged: identical reduce level 62,964.3 derived from the same session-low rule, identical bias of range with a bearish tilt, identical skew of 2.23, identical long/short liquidation split of $123,194 against $35,428, and the same finding that open interest turned up after five declines. Two independent derivations landing on the same numbers is corroboration and it raises confidence in the level. One disagreement is worth recording rather than hiding. Midnight rated endday's fired reduce line at 63,043.4 as having HELPED, on the ground that four consecutive 1H bars settled below it with no reclaim on any settled bar - the first break this week not reclaimed within an hour or two. Read at the mark instead of at the bars, the same trade looks like a loss: spot is 63,060.5 now, 17.1 points above the exit, so a wallet that respected the line sold the low of a failed breakdown and would buy back higher. Midnight's row stands as written and is not being rewritten; both readings are defensible and the disagreement is itself the useful record, because it shows the rating depends entirely on whether the level is judged on settled bars or on the mark at the next report. The second finding is the add gate. 63,309.4 has now been republished seven consecutive times without one test, the session high falling 153.6 points short again today. This report breaks with midnight and moves the gate to 63,155.8, the session high, so that both ends of the box generate a testable claim each session rather than one end generating six months of nulls.
